g.text: Every deploy (manual or CD) is recorded to the GitHub Deployments API; roll back by redeploying an older immutable tag.
Rollback handles are IMMUTABLE tags: vX.Y.Z rolls ALL services back atomically; sha-<git> rolls one service. Never roll back to latest.
Local: IMAGE_TAG=v1.2.3 ./deploy-all.sh uat --only … -y · GitHub: Actions → Run workflow (env, image_tag, services). Ledger never fails a deploy.
